#### struct `ParticlePoolStats`

Counters of one ParticlePools (diagnostics, tests).

```cpp
struct ParticlePoolStats {
    std::uint32_t pools = 0;                                    // live pools (draining included)
    std::uint32_t alive = 0;                                    // live particles
    std::uint32_t reserved = 0;                                 // sum of live pool capacities (<= max_particles)
    std::uint32_t rejected = 0;                                 // create() calls refused (over budget or no slot)
    std::uint32_t replaced = 0;                                 // particles overwritten because their pool was full
    std::uint32_t drawn = 0;                                    // quads pushed by the last draw()
    std::uint32_t culled = 0;                                   // particles skipped by the last draw()
    std::uint32_t slab_size = 0;                                // particle slots allocated (grows to its working size)
};
```

#### class `ParticlePools`

A world's particle pools. A full pool overwrites its particles in turn; the shared slab only grows until it reaches its working size. Not snapshotted or hashed.

```cpp
class ParticlePools {                                           // World resource (init_world)
public:
    // One live particle (36 bytes, trivially copyable).
    struct Particle {
        Vec2 position;                                          // world/screen px (local space: relative to the anchor)
        Vec2 velocity;                                          // px/s
        float age = 0, life = 1;                                // seconds; dies when age >= life
        float rotation = 0, spin = 0;                           // radians, radians/s
        float phase = 0;                                        // sway phase, radians
    };
    // max_particles caps the summed pool capacities; max_pools is the number of pool slots.
    explicit ParticlePools(std::uint32_t max_particles = 65536, std::uint32_t max_pools = 256);
    ParticlePools(const ParticlePools &) = delete;
    ParticlePools &operator=(const ParticlePools &) = delete;
    // None if over budget or out of slots. May move the slab, invalidating particles() spans.
    ParticlePoolId create(const EmitterConfig &c);
    // Frees the pool and its particles now. Stale or none ids are ignored.
    void destroy(ParticlePoolId pool);
    // Stop emitting and destroy the pool once its last particle dies, so trails fade out.
    void release(ParticlePoolId pool);
    // True for a live pool (draining pools included).
    bool valid(ParticlePoolId pool) const;
    // Emits `count` particles at `origin` (plus the spawn area). Local-space pools also move their
    // anchor there. Ignored for stale or draining pools.
    void emit(ParticlePoolId pool, Vec2 origin, std::uint16_t count, Rng &rng);
    // Emits `count` particles spread evenly along the emitter's move from `from` to `to`, each
    // pre-aged by its share of `seconds`, so streams look the same at any frame rate.
    void emit_stream(ParticlePoolId pool, Vec2 from, Vec2 to, std::uint32_t count, float seconds,
                     Rng &rng);
    // Anchor for local-space particles; `rotation` turns the emission angle and spawn area.
    void set_origin(ParticlePoolId pool, Vec2 origin, float rotation = 0);
    // Replaces the config. A capacity change moves the pool, keeping what fits; false if that
    // would go over budget. Like create(), invalidates particles() spans.
    bool set_config(ParticlePoolId pool, const EmitterConfig &c);
    // The pool's sanitized config; null for stale ids. Valid until destroy/set_config.
    const EmitterConfig *config(ParticlePoolId pool) const;
    // Kills every particle of one pool (stale ids ignored), or of every pool.
    void clear(ParticlePoolId pool);
    void clear();
    // Ages every particle by dt (gravity and drag integrated exactly) and destroys drained pools.
    void update(float dt, Rng &rng);
    // One quad per visible particle; world layers are culled against visible_world.
    void draw(RenderQueue &q, const Rect &visible_world) const;
    // Same, but screen layers are also culled against visible_screen (virtual px).
    void draw(RenderQueue &q, const Rect &visible_world, const Rect &visible_screen) const;
    // Live particles of a pool, in no particular order. Invalidated by create() or set_config() on
    // any pool, and by most calls on this one.
    std::span<const Particle> particles(ParticlePoolId pool) const;
    // Live particles of one pool (0 for stale ids), and of every pool.
    std::uint32_t alive(ParticlePoolId pool) const;
    std::uint32_t total_alive() const;
    // Capacity of a live pool; 0 for stale ids.
    std::uint32_t capacity(ParticlePoolId pool) const;
    // The budget and the number of pool slots given to the constructor.
    std::uint32_t max_particles() const;
    std::uint32_t max_pools() const;
    // Counters; drawn/culled refer to the last draw().
    ParticlePoolStats stats() const;
};
```

```cpp
    StrId back_kind = str_id("back");                           // SceneMessage kind sent by back
    StrId initial_focus;                                        // none: the first enabled item
    AssetId<UiTheme> theme;                                     // none: the built-in theme
    float width = 0;                                            // panel width; 0 = fit the items
};
```

#### class `MenuScene`

A Scene that shows `spec` in its world's UiTree and pops itself with the chosen item's SceneMessage at the next tick boundary. Subclass it to add hooks (see MenuState).

```cpp
class MenuScene : public Scene {
public:
    explicit MenuScene(MenuSpec spec);
    std::string_view name() const override;                     // "lam.menu"
    // Builds the widgets, inserts MenuState and adds the menu's frame and tick systems.
    void enter(App &app, World &world) override;
    bool overlay() const override;                              // spec().overlay
    const MenuSpec &spec() const;
protected:
    MenuSpec spec_;
};
```

```cpp
std::unique_ptr<Scene> make_confirm_scene(std::string_view question, StrId yes_kind,
                                          StrId no_kind = str_id("no"));
```

"Yes"/"No" question. Focus starts on "No" (the safe answer); back answers no_kind. A question longer than the 47-byte title becomes the body text.

```cpp
std::unique_ptr<Scene> make_settings_scene(std::span<const MenuItem> extra = {});
```

Audio volumes, fullscreen, key rebinding and (LAM_DEV) show FPS, saved to SettingsStore, then the `extra` items and Back. Closes with SceneMessage{"back"}.

```cpp
std::unique_ptr<Scene> make_text_scene(std::string_view title, std::string body);
```

Scrolling text page (credits, help) with a Close button. Closes with SceneMessage{"close"}.

```cpp
inline constexpr StrId kMenuSelectIntent = str_id("menu.select");  // a = item index, b = payload
inline constexpr StrId kMenuBackIntent = str_id("menu.back");
inline constexpr StrId kMenuRebindItem = str_id("input.rebind");  // settings: rebind buttons
```

```cpp
using MenuChangeFn = void (*)(App &app, MenuState &state, std::size_t item, float value);
```

Frame-time hooks of special menus (settings, text). Plain function pointers.

```cpp
using MenuClickFn = bool (*)(App &app, MenuState &state, std::size_t item);  // true: handled
using MenuFrameFn = void (*)(App &app, MenuState &state, UiTree &tree, const FrameInput &input);
```

#### struct `MenuState`

```cpp
struct MenuState {                                              // World resource of a menu world
    MenuSpec spec;
    std::vector<UiId> nodes;                                    // nodes[i]: widget of spec.items[i]
    UiId root = 0, panel = 0, list = 0, body = 0;
    MenuChangeFn on_change = nullptr;                           // after a value widget changed
    MenuClickFn on_click = nullptr;                             // before a click becomes an intent
    MenuFrameFn on_frame = nullptr;                             // every frame after ui_update
    bool closed = false;                                        // closing: later intents are ignored
    std::optional<SceneMessage> result;                         // the message it closed with
    std::int64_t hook_state = 0;                                // free for the hooks (settings: capture)
    std::array<Intent, kMaxIntents> pending{};                  // fallback without InputSystem
    std::uint8_t pending_count = 0;
};
```

```cpp
MenuState build_menu(UiTree &tree, MenuSpec spec, Vec2 screen);
```

Builds the menu widgets into `tree` and focuses the initial item. ui_update later shrinks the item list (then the body) if the panel doesn't fit on screen.

```cpp
int menu_item_index(const MenuState &state, UiId node);
```

The index of the item whose widget is `node`; -1 if none.

```cpp
std::optional<Intent> menu_event_intent(const MenuState &state, const UiTree &tree,
                                        const UiEvent &e);
```

The intent a UiEvent turns into: click or submit -> "menu.select" (a = index, b = payload), back -> "menu.back". nullopt otherwise, or once the menu is closing.

```cpp
std::optional<SceneMessage> menu_intent_message(MenuState &state, const Intent &intent);
```

The message the menu closes with for `intent`. Reads only the intent and spec, so replays match. Marks the menu closed; nullopt for intents that don't close it.

```cpp
void menu_settings_change(App &app, MenuState &state, std::size_t item, float value);
```

Default on_change: writes `value` to the SettingsStore key named by the item's id, if defined.

### lam/ui/message_log.h

```cpp
#include <lam/ui/message_log.h>
```

Source: [`src/ui/include/lam/ui/message_log.h`](../src/ui/include/lam/ui/message_log.h). Namespaces: `lam`.

Roguelike message log: a ring of fixed-size lines, no allocation after construction.

#### class `MessageLog`

```cpp
class MessageLog {                                              // World or App resource (game's choice)
public:
    explicit MessageLog(std::size_t lines = 64);                // lines >= 1
    void add(std::string_view text, Color c = kWhite);          // truncates to 96 bytes
    std::size_t size() const;                                   // lines kept (<= capacity)
    std::string_view line(std::size_t i) const;                 // 0 = oldest kept; valid until add/clear
    Color color(std::size_t i) const;                           // colour of line(i)
    void clear();                                               // drops every line; keeps the storage
    std::size_t capacity() const;                               // lines kept before the oldest drops
    // Lines added since construction (clear() does not reset it): views redraw when it changes.
    std::uint64_t added() const;
};
```

### lam/ui/toasts.h

```cpp
#include <lam/ui/toasts.h>
```

Source: [`src/ui/include/lam/ui/toasts.h`](../src/ui/include/lam/ui/toasts.h). Namespaces: `lam`.

Toast notifications. Fixed capacity; duplicates merge into one toast with a count, and when full the oldest is dropped.

#### class `ToastQueue`

Short notifications at the bottom of the screen (App resource of UiPlugin).

```cpp
class ToastQueue {
public:
    // remaining: seconds left; alpha: 0..1 (fades in over 0.15 s, out over the last 0.4 s);
    // count: identical pushes merged into this toast; age: seconds since it (re)appeared.
    struct Toast {
        FixedString<64> text;
        Color color = kWhite;
        float remaining = 0;
        float alpha = 1;
        std::uint16_t count = 1;
        float age = 0;
    };
    explicit ToastQueue(std::size_t capacity = 8);              // capacity >= 1
    // Shows `text` for `seconds` (at least 0.6). If the same text is already showing, that toast
    // restarts and its count goes up instead.
    void push(std::string_view text, float seconds = 2.5f, Color c = kWhite);
    void update(float dt);                                      // real seconds; dt <= 0 does nothing
    std::span<const Toast> toasts() const;                      // oldest first; valid until push/update
    void clear();                                               // removes every toast
    std::size_t capacity() const;                               // toasts shown at once
};
```

### lam/ui/ui.h

```cpp
#include <lam/ui/ui.h>
```

Source: [`src/ui/include/lam/ui/ui.h`](../src/ui/include/lam/ui/ui.h). Namespaces: `lam`.

Retained UI: one UiTree per world, drawn through RenderQueue at screen layers. UiEvent is presentation only; to change the game, queue an intent.

```cpp
using UiId = std::uint32_t;                                     // 0 = none
```

Slot index in the low 16 bits, generation in the high 16, so stale ids read as absent.

#### enum `UiKind`

Widget kinds. Button, Toggle, Slider, Choice and TextInput are interactive (always focusable).

```cpp
enum class UiKind : std::uint8_t { Panel, Label, Button, Toggle, Slider, Choice, Image, List, TextInput, TextBlock };
```

#### enum `UiLayout`

How a container places its visible children: None = by anchor/pivot/rect; Vertical and Horizontal stack them (anchor aligns across the stack); Grid fills style.grid_columns columns.

```cpp
enum class UiLayout : std::uint8_t { None, Vertical, Horizontal, Grid };
```

#### struct `UiStyle`

Per-node style: theme class (UiThemeClass::id; none = the base theme), inner padding (pixels), spacing between stacked children (pixels) and the column count of Grid layouts.

```cpp
struct UiStyle {
    StrId theme_class;
    Vec2 padding{4, 4};
    float spacing = 2;
    std::uint8_t grid_columns = 1;
};
```

```cpp
inline constexpr int kMaxUiChoices = 8;
```

Choices per Choice widget (the index is always clamped into [0, choice_count)).

#### enum `UiFill`

UiNode::fill bits: take the parent's content width/height (None layouts and stacks' cross axis).

```cpp
enum UiFill : std::uint8_t { kUiFillX = 1, kUiFillY = 2 };
```

#### struct `UiNode`

One widget. Read and edit it through UiTree::get; `parent` is set by UiTree::add and must not be changed afterwards (the tree keeps its own child links).

```cpp
struct UiNode {
    UiKind kind = UiKind::Panel;
    UiId parent = 0;
    StrId id;                                                   // reported in UiEvent; UiTree::find
    Rect rect;                                                  // relative; w/h 0 = natural size
    Vec2 anchor{0, 0}, pivot{0, 0};                             // 0..1 of the parent / own size
    UiLayout layout = UiLayout::None;
    UiStyle style;
    FixedString<64> text;                                       // label of every text widget
    bool enabled = true, visible = true, focusable = false;     // invisible: no space, no input
    float value = 0, min = 0, max = 1, step = 0.1f;             // slider / toggle / choice index
    std::array<FixedString<24>, kMaxUiChoices> choices{};
    std::uint8_t choice_count = 0;                              // 0 on a Choice: integer stepper min..max
    TextureRegion image;
    std::uint16_t scroll = 0;                                   // List: first child; TextBlock: line
    std::uint8_t fill = 0;                                      // UiFill bits
    Vec2 max_size{0, 0};                                        // caps the natural size; 0 = no cap
    Color color = kTransparent;                                 // alpha != 0 overrides the theme
    StrId intent;                                               // queued as Intent{intent, intent_a, value}
    std::int64_t intent_a = 0;
};
```

#### struct `UiEvent`

A user action: Clicked (button, focusable image or panel), Changed (value widgets; `value` is the new value), Focused, Back (node = the focus or 0) or Submitted (text field).

```cpp
struct UiEvent {                                                // World event (Update -800)
    enum class Kind : std::uint8_t { Clicked, Changed, Focused, Back, Submitted };
    Kind kind = Kind::Clicked;
    UiId node = 0;                                              // the widget (0 for Back without focus)
    StrId id;                                                   // its UiNode::id
    float value = 0;                                            // its UiNode::value after the action
};
```

#### struct `UiThemeClass`

A theme class (".theme.json" "classes"): every field starts as the base theme's value.

```cpp
struct UiThemeClass {
    StrId id;                                                   // UiStyle::theme_class that selects it
    float font_size = 0;                                        // 0 = the theme's
    Color text{240, 240, 240, 255}, text_disabled{120, 120, 120, 255};  // as in UiTheme
    Color panel{24, 24, 32, 230}, panel_border{90, 90, 110, 255};
    Color button{48, 48, 64, 255}, button_focus{80, 80, 120, 255}, button_down{30, 30, 40, 255};
    bool background = true;                                     // panels and lists draw a fill/frame
    TextAlign align = TextAlign::Left;                          // labels; buttons centre unless set
    bool align_set = false;                                     // "align" given in the JSON
};
```

#### struct `UiTheme`

Colours, font and nine-slice of a tree (UiTree::set_theme). Widgets tint the nine-slice with panel / button / button_focus / button_down; without one they draw flat fills and 1 px frames.

```cpp
struct UiTheme {                                                // asset ".theme.json"; built-in default if none
    AssetId<Font> font;                                         // none: RenderDefaults::font
    float font_size = 0;                                        // pixels; 0 = the font's base size
    // Text, panel fill/frame and button fills (idle, focused, pressed); classes override them.
    Color text{240, 240, 240, 255}, text_disabled{120, 120, 120, 255};
    Color panel{24, 24, 32, 230}, panel_border{90, 90, 110, 255};
    Color button{48, 48, 64, 255}, button_focus{80, 80, 120, 255}, button_down{30, 30, 40, 255};
    Color overlay_dim{0, 0, 0, 140};                            // behind modal popups
    TextureRegion nine_slice;                                   // none -> flat colours
    float nine_slice_border = 4;
    StrId click_sound, focus_sound;                             // PlaySound groups (optional)
    std::vector<UiThemeClass> classes;                          // sorted by id value; load time only
    StrId atlas_group = str_id("default");                      // none = "atlas": "none"
    // The class `id`; null for none or unknown ids (callers fall back to the base theme).
    const UiThemeClass *find_class(StrId id) const;
    // The base theme as a class (id none): what every class starts from.
    UiThemeClass base_class() const;
};
```

```cpp
const UiTheme &default_ui_theme();
```

The built-in theme (no font: RenderDefaults::font is used). Static storage.

```cpp
template <class T> class AssetLoader;                           // <lam/assets/asset_server.h>
```

```cpp
Result<UiTheme> parse_ui_theme(std::string_view json, std::string_view file_name,
                               LoadContext *deps = nullptr);
```

Parses a .theme.json document (strict). Font and nine-slice paths become dependencies through `deps`; with null they're checked but left unset.

```cpp
std::unique_ptr<AssetLoader<UiTheme>> make_ui_theme_loader();
```

The ".theme.json" loader (UiPlugin registers it). Finalize packs the nine-slice image into the theme's atlas group when its pixels are present, else keeps the standalone texture.

#### struct `UiInput`

One frame of input for a UiTree, independent of lam_input so navigation is testable. ui_update fills it from FrameInput + UiNav (directions use is_repeated, so held keys repeat).

```cpp
struct UiInput {
    bool up = false, down = false, left = false, right = false;  // pressed or repeated this frame
    bool confirm = false, back = false;                         // pressed this frame
    bool erase = false;                                         // TextInput backspace (repeats)
    Vec2 pointer;                                               // virtual pixels
    bool pointer_valid = false;
    bool pointer_down = false, pointer_pressed = false, pointer_released = false;  // left / touch 0
    float wheel = 0;                                            // > 0 scrolls lists up
    std::span<const char32_t> typed;                            // TextInput text this frame
};
```

#### class `UiTree`

```cpp
class UiTree {                                                  // World resource (init_world)
public:
    UiTree();
    ~UiTree();
    UiTree(const UiTree &) = delete;
    UiTree &operator=(const UiTree &) = delete;
    // Adds `n` as the last child of `parent` (0 = a root). Returns 0 if `parent` is dead.
    // Interactive kinds become focusable.
    UiId add(UiId parent, const UiNode &n);
    // Builders: add() with the kind's defaults. Text is truncated to fit FixedString<64>.
    UiId panel(UiId parent, Rect r, UiLayout l = UiLayout::Vertical);  // r.w/h 0: fit children
    UiId label(UiId parent, std::string_view text);             // not focusable; skipped by navigation
    UiId button(UiId parent, StrId id, std::string_view label);  // Clicked on confirm / click
    UiId toggle(UiId parent, StrId id, std::string_view label, bool on);  // value 0/1; Changed
    // Value in [mn, mx] snapped to `step` from mn (0 = (mx - mn) / 10); left/right step, drag sets.
    UiId slider(UiId parent, StrId id, std::string_view label, float v, float mn, float mx,
                float step = 0.1f);
    // Value = the selected index (clamped); left/right and clicks on the arrows cycle, wrapping.
    UiId choice(UiId parent, StrId id, std::string_view label,
                std::span<const std::string_view> choices, int selected);
    UiId list(UiId parent, Rect r);                             // vertical scrolling list (clips)
    UiId text_block(UiId parent, Rect r, std::string text);     // long text; laid out once (allocates)
    // A scrolling grid: a List with Grid layout and `columns` columns (inventories, level select).
    UiId grid(UiId parent, Rect r, int columns);
    // An image of `region` (size 0 = the region's size); focusable when `id` is not none.
    UiId image(UiId parent, const TextureRegion &region, Vec2 size = {}, StrId id = {});
    // Single-line text field. Confirm emits Submitted and moves focus down; while it's focused the
    // direction keys type instead of navigating.
    UiId text_input(UiId parent, StrId id, std::string_view initial = {});
    void remove(UiId id);                                       // and children
    UiNode *get(UiId id);                                       // valid until the next add/remove
    const UiNode *get(UiId id) const;                           // null for dead or stale ids
    UiId find(StrId id) const;                                  // first live node with that id; 0 if none
    void set_text(UiId id, std::string_view text);              // no allocation; marks layout dirty
    void set_value(UiId id, float value);                       // sanitised like add(); no event
    void focus(UiId id);                                        // programmatic: no Focused event; 0 clears
    UiId focused() const;                                       // 0 if none (or it died)
    void set_theme(AssetId<UiTheme> theme);                     // none: default_ui_theme()
    void clear();                                               // removes every node; old ids stay dead
    std::size_t size() const;                                   // live nodes
    bool alive(UiId id) const;                                  // id names a live node
    AssetId<UiTheme> theme() const;                             // as given to set_theme
    // TextBlock text (allocates when it grows); set_text on a TextBlock does the same.
    void set_block_text(UiId id, std::string text);
    std::string_view block_text(UiId id) const;                 // "" for other kinds
    // Typewriter reveal of a TextBlock: at most `glyphs` glyphs are drawn; -1 = all.
    void set_reveal(UiId id, int glyphs);
    // Replaces a Choice's options (truncated to kMaxUiChoices and 23 bytes each).
    void set_choices(UiId id, std::span<const std::string_view> choices, int selected);
    // Children in order (0 when there are none / at the end).
    UiId first_child(UiId id) const;                            // id 0: the first root
    UiId next_sibling(UiId id) const;
    std::size_t child_count(UiId id) const;
    // Confines navigation and pointer input to this subtree (0 = whole tree), for modal popups.
    void set_focus_root(UiId root);
    UiId focus_root() const;
    // Scrolls a List by `rows` (grid rows), or a TextBlock by lines; clamped.
    void scroll_by(UiId id, int rows);
    // Scrolls every List ancestor so `id` is visible, deferred to the next layout if needed.
    void scroll_into_view(UiId id);
    // Lays out every node inside `screen` (virtual pixels). Labels re-measure and TextBlocks
    // re-wrap only when something they depend on changed. Null font: 6x8 fallback metrics.
    void layout(Rect screen, const UiTheme &theme, const Font *font);
    // One frame of input, after layout(). Each action produces at most one event.
    void handle_input(const UiInput &in);
    std::span<const UiEvent> events() const;                    // since clear_events(); max 64
    void clear_events();
    bool layout_dirty() const;                                  // input changed text, values or scroll
    // After layout(): screen rect, whether it was placed (not hidden or scrolled out), and clip.
    Rect screen_rect(UiId id) const;
    bool shown(UiId id) const;
    Rect clip_rect(UiId id) const;                              // {} = unclipped
    // Slider bar, toggle box or choice value area inside the widget ({} for other kinds).
    Rect value_rect(UiId id) const;
    // Topmost shown node under `p` (any kind; respects clips and the focus root); 0 if none.
    UiId hit_test(Vec2 p) const;
    UiId hovered() const;                                       // focusable node under the pointer
    UiId pressed() const;                                       // pointer pressed on it, not released
    std::uint32_t structure_version() const;                    // ++ on every add/remove/clear
    // Text scale (theme class size / font base size) of node `id` in the last layout.
    float text_scale(UiId id) const;
    // Diagnostics: label measures and TextBlock wraps by layout(), and events over the cap.
    struct Stats {
        std::uint32_t measures = 0, wraps = 0, dropped_events = 0;
    };
    Stats stats() const;
    struct Slot;                                                // private storage (ui_tree.cpp)
    struct Frame;
};
```

## Reflected types

Every `LAM_REFLECT*` registration in the public headers. Reflected component types register themselves during static initialisation (see [lam/ecs/component.h](#lamecscomponenth)).

| Type | Macro | Kind and flags | Fields or names | Header |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lam::Ease` | `LAM_REFLECT_ENUM` | enum names | `"linear"`, `"in_quad"`, `"out_quad"`, `"in_out_quad"`, `"in_cubic"`, `"out_cubic"`, `"in_out_cubic"`, `"in_sine"`, `"out_sine"`, `"in_out_sine"`, `"in_expo"`, `"out_expo"`, `"in_out_expo"`, `"in_back"`, `"out_back"`, `"in_out_back"`, `"out_bounce"`, `"out_elastic"`, `"step"` | [lam/ecs/component.h](#lamecscomponenth) |
| `lam::Lifetime` | `LAM_REFLECT` | `lam::kDefaultFlags` (component) | `ticks` | [lam/ecs/lifetime.h](#lamecslifetimeh) |
| `lam::Transform` | `LAM_REFLECT` | `lam::kDefaultFlags` (component) | `position`, `rotation`, `scale` | [lam/ecs/transform.h](#lamecstransformh) |
| `lam::PrevTransform` | `LAM_REFLECT_FLAGS` | `lam::kSnapshot` (component) | `position`, `rotation`, `scale` | [lam/ecs/transform.h](#lamecstransformh) |
| `lam::Parent` | `LAM_REFLECT` | `lam::kDefaultFlags` (component) | `entity`, `local` | [lam/ecs/transform.h](#lamecstransformh) |
| `lam::Children` | `LAM_REFLECT_FLAGS` | `lam::kSnapshot` (component) | `first`, `count` | [lam/ecs/transform.h](#lamecstransformh) |
| `lam::Name` | `LAM_REFLECT` | `lam::kDefaultFlags` (component) | `id` | [lam/ecs/transform.h](#lamecstransformh) |
| `lam::TurnActor` | `LAM_REFLECT` | `lam::kDefaultFlags` (component) | `energy`, `speed` | [lam/ecs/turns.h](#lamecsturnsh) |
| `lam::PlayerTurn` | `LAM_REFLECT_TAG` | `kTag \| kSerialize \| kSnapshot \| kHash` (tag component) |  | [lam/ecs/turns.h](#lamecsturnsh) |
| `lam::TurnScheduler` | `LAM_REFLECT` | `lam::kDefaultFlags` (component) | `current`, `busy`, `max_actors_per_tick`, `acted_this_tick`, `last_tick`, `turns` | [lam/ecs/turns.h](#lamecsturnsh) |
